authorization_contract.owner: The respective public publishers and the repository owner for new audit files

authorization_contract.in_scope_asset: Official public documents and the new public policy-and-code package

authorization_contract.stop_condition: Stop before personal-case disclosure, nonpublic data, appointment assertion, expenditure commitment or third-party contact

root_set.scope: Public authority treatment, social-service access and accessibility
General entrance listening-room duty and repair-budget pilot

countermodels.description: The first visible entrance function is safety and access control.
A listening person handles all situations without a separate safety function.
Listening and safety are simultaneously reachable, with separate authority and an explicit handoff.

proven: Official sources establish constitutional, social-administration, accessibility, work-safety, pay, budget and measurement anchors within their separate scopes.
The local model rejects a listening role with enforcement powers and requires a separate safety function.
The local model keeps personal compensation independent of population satisfaction.
The local model can calculate an increased synthetic institutional repair-budget candidate after a valid low-satisfaction measurement and holds decreases behind a multi-period release guard.
falsified: The cited federal sources already impose the complete proposed room at every authority entrance.
A low satisfaction value can directly change an individual worker's salary in this model.
The 100,000-euro illustrative reference is used by the calculator.
A structural validator result appoints a person, commits funds or proves effectiveness.
deepest_unknown: Whether the proposed dual-function entrance design improves dignified access and safety at acceptable cost across materially different authorities.
why_unknown: No authorized multi-site pilot with representative outcome, cost, safety, accessibility and adverse-effect measurements is included.
next_safe_experiment: A voluntary, time-limited, independently evaluated pilot using an existing accessible room, trained staffing, a separate safety plan and data-minimized metrics.
stop_condition: Stop before compulsory participation, personal profiling, hidden recording, replacement of formal remedies, automatic financial execution or appointment claims.
reopen_trigger: A published pilot protocol, enacted legal basis, collective agreement, budget decision or representative multi-period evaluation.
